course_name_original: Katılımcı Kent Yönetiminde Proje Yönetim Süreci
course_name_en: Project Management Process in Participatory Urban Governance

learning_outcomes.text: The student learns the development process of local governments in Turkey.
The student reinforces the concepts of urban governance and participatory governance.
The student grasps the place and importance of project management within management approaches.
The student grasps the impact of project management specifically in urban governance.
The student learns the steps of project management.
The student examines the functioning of project management in participatory urban planning through national and international examples.

syllabus_topics: Development of Local Governments in Turkey
What is Participation in Urban Governance? How does it happen? Concept and Elements of Participatory Urban Governance
What is Project Management? Why is it done? What is its place in Urban Governance? Project Management-Urban Governance Relationship and Basic Concepts
Introduction to Project Management Application Steps: Project/Program Management - General Concepts
Which steps does Project Management consist of? Project Management Process Steps
From which areas is knowledge obtained for Project Management? Project Management Process Knowledge Areas (1)
From which areas is knowledge obtained for Project Management? Project Management Process Knowledge Areas (2)
What is Strategic Management of Communication? Concept of Strategic Communication Management and its Role in Participatory Processes
Project Management Case Study in Participatory Urban Governance (1)
Midterm Exam 2 - Project Management Case Study in Participatory Urban Governance (1)
Project Management Case Study in Participatory Urban Governance (2)
